bagPolicy.summary: All bags are subject to inspection at entry. The Nashville FAQ does not state a maximum size or clear-bag requirement.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue has no parking lot; nearby paid lots and street parking are available.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Nashville FAQ lists nearby parking but no designated rideshare pickup or drop-off location.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The restaurant and bar open at 5 p.m. on show days; the venue is cashless, with a cash-to-card option onsite.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The Nashville venue offers limited seating for guests with access needs; staff can help on arrival.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Nashville FAQ mentions searches each time a guest enters or re-enters but does not publish a general permission or condition for re-entry.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office opens at 5 p.m. on show days and electronic tickets can be scanned from a phone. The venue does not publish a will-call collection process.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Concert admission is screened using security wands, metal detectors or bag searches. For most shows Fast Lane access may be offered, but it does not include a show ticket.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
